subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Event!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our exclusive summer sale event starting next week! Enjoy up to 50% off on select items, including summer essentials like swimwear, sunglasses, and beach towels. Don't miss this opportunity to refresh your wardrobe for the season. Visit our store or shop online to take advantage of these amazing deals. Hurry, limited stock available! Best regards, The Sales Team
